triggers.fact: Parent company Eternal injected Rs 450 crore into Blinkit via a rights issue in April 2026 to fund its quick commerce expansion.
Blinkit secured a ₹600 crore capital infusion in December 2025 specifically to support aggressive dark store network expansion.
Blinkit is actively pushing into Tier-2 cities as part of its geographic expansion strategy as of August 2026.
Blinkit's careers page states that they only accept job applications through employee referrals.

pain_hypothesis: As Blinkit aggressively expands dark store operations into Tier-2 cities, relying strictly on employee referrals creates a major bottleneck for sourcing and coordinating high-volume entry-level talent across regional campuses.
